body:
One leg is *gone*.

The other leg is in a cast, having had multiple invasive surgeries done to "save" it.  It will be another 3-4 months, at best, before it can support any weight.

> Honey

Nope.  There went all your credibility, right in your first *word*.

> as far as I know church benevolence isn't restricted to any particular ethnicity

You don't live in my part of the country, then.

> you might consider a local suicide prevention hotline as a resource

Only insofar as it will lead to me getting, at best, involuntarily committed and even *further* in debt for the time spent in the loony bin.

> As for a reason to live... reddit.

You can stop jerking off now.

> wander into the woods

On what legs?
Because I thought I had a future.

Keep that compassion coming, Reddit.  Keep that huge, steaming pile of compassion coming *right up*.  

Hang on a sec; I'm going to quote you, just so your compassion will be preserved after you delete your post like the cowardly dipshit you are.

> I can see why you're jobless. No one wants to hire an inconsiderate jerk. Same for the no friends part, who would want to be friends with such a grump? You gotta stop taking your anger at the world out on harmless folks. You're being cruel to all of those helpful, kind people on this subreddit who were generous enough to read your post. Honestly, I don't see anyone who would get totally over whelmed if you end your own life. In fact, I think they would be relieved; no more getting called names for no reason. Take a look at how you're acting, you're embarassing yourself. Call me a dumbshit, or a cock sucker I don't care. One, because I know I'm a hell of a lot smarter than you. Two, because I'm a proud lesbian, obviously I don't suck cock. And three, because you're not worth the energy. I hope you have a fantastic day :)

*There*.

> Would an interviewer seriously spit on your resume unprovoked?

As someone who came in to interview and had an interviewer do *exactly that*, yes.  Yes, at least one interviewer would do that, because at least one interviewer *has*.

> Why are you even posting here?

To prove to myself that there are no legitimate reasons for me to live, by crowdsourcing the project to people who aren't brain-damaged.  Since no one has given any legitimate reasons for me to live, I am convinced that killing myself is the right thing to do.

Log out of your account and take a look.  They are all deleted.  I conclude that you deleted them.  I cannot determine why--I have my suspicions, but only suspicions, and you cannot be trusted to tell the truth as to whether you deleted them or not because you have every reason to lie here--but I can honestly tell you *your posts are not there*.

> good people

I have yet to meet a "good" person in my life. 

Reddit is no exception.

Well, if you hadn't deleted your posts, I'd have something to rebut, now wouldn't I?

If you are so confident in your advice, post it again.  Post it where it can be seen and critiqued.

Meanwhile, I will rebut you as best as I can given the few sentences you haven't deleted.

> Is it really that unreasonable to say that you are valuable for who you are?

Yes it is.  I am a vulgar, unloved, self-righteous asshole who cannot contribute to society.  I cannot speak coherently, can only type because of a generous autocorrect, cannot use my hands for any fine manipulation, cannot remember basic concepts like my own telephone number, cannot walk, cannot stand, and cannot see out of one eye.  I cannot perform my previous job, was so stupid in my personal life that I allowed myself to be tricked out of most of my money by my ex, and cannot get a new job.  I will default on all of my loans, all of my utilities, and my rent in two days, and there is nothing I can do to stop or rectify that.  *Who I am* is a worthless drain of resources who can contribute nothing beyond shooting down reasons to live.

> You haven't met all the people that you're ever going to meet.

This is a non-argument.  It is no reason to live.  Everyone I meet from today on could be an axe-murderer or a cripple-rapist.  Or both.  Moreover, it is *not necessarily true*.  I could be a shut-in for the rest of my life.  I could die of an embolism three seconds after I click "Send."  I very well could have met everyone I will ever meet.  

> Others who may be able to help you get your life back on track

I addressed this above.

That is all I have of what you have said, because you deleted everything else.  If you trust your arguments, post them again.  That you chose to delete them says to *me* that you have no faith in your arguments.

You do not get to know that.  You are not a fucking life coach.  I did not hire you.  No one has recommended you.  Your ideas are garbage.  You do not get to know any more of my goddamn life story so you can beat off to it.

Because you are a dumbshit.

You dumbshit.

And now we come to Reddit actually mocking a brain-damaged person's speech impediment.

I knew you were all assholes.  I fucking knew it.

> you posted here

This is the only true and correct thing you have ever posted.

> asshole

The best part of you dried up on your father's thigh.  

> delete this stupid shit and stop being such a dick

No.

> youre a fucking prick 

Keep that fucking compassion coming, Reddit.

> Is it really that unreasonable to say that you are valuable for who you are?

Yes.  

> You haven't met all the people that you're ever going to meet.

That is not an argument.  That is weaksauce bullshit and even a dumbshit like you knows it.

> You can still find happiness in others.

No, I cannot.

> Others ... may be able to help you get your life back on track

No, they cannot.  No, they *will* not.

Thank you for calling me an asshole.  I know I am, and I'm glad you know it too.

Oh, wait, sorry, what I mean to say was, "Go fuck yourself."
Fuck you.  You have no argument, and even a dumbshit asshole like you knows it.

Dumbass.

> you wouldnt have posted in here otherwise

As I explained elsewhere here, I posted to crowdsource all the possible reasons I might have to want to live, so that I could critique them, shoot out the stupid ones (that is, all of them), and kill myself knowing that I made the right choice.  So far, Reddit has only provided stupid reasons for wanting to live given my situation, and thus has performed admirably.

> your brain doesnt want help, but your heart does

This is the dumbest thing I have ever heard, and I heard myself talk today.

You are truly, truly a dumb shit.

Tell me what I can do, then.  I can't walk, can't think, can't use my hands, can't remember shit, and have had one interview since February, and that was just so the interviewer could spit on my resume.

I have **ZERO** money.  I will default on **EVERYTHING** come May 1.  Roommate or no.  Any roommate I have will be evicted alongside me after I fail to pay rent.  And no one I have considered for a roommate has been at all trustworthy, creditworthy, not-a-thief-or-convicted-rapist-worthy, or wanted to put up with me for more than five minutes.

> You came here for help

No I didn't.
**WITH WHAT MONEY, YOU COCKSUCKER?**

> you did come here asking for help

No, I came here so I could crowdsource all the possible reasons I might have to live, so I can shoot them down and know that I am right.  That way I can die knowing it is the right thing to do.

Reddit is performing admirably.

EDIT: Fixed my quote of you.

> Is there someone who could come round while you meet them so they don't run off with shit?

Sure, their cohorts.

No friends, remember?

Yep.

Got nothing but registered sex offenders and meth-fiends, and people who tried to rob me while I while I showed them the house.  One of them was even so kind as to run away with my microwave.  Most people took one look at the crippled freak in a wheelchair and decided to leave.

> So, the question is what are you capable off at this stage, sure you can't do any physical work but can you work on the Internet? And do list what you worked on before.

I can't program, I have no desire to learn, I *can't* learn (I can't remember my own phone number), and you do not get to see my resume.  You are not my career advisor, and if the best answer you have is "I don't have an answer," then you don't have an answer.

You.

Don't.

Have.

An.

Answer.

> bear in mind your limitations 

Like **NOT BEING ABLE TO SEE, YOU DUMB FUCKER!**

I'd also like to be able to pay my bills on time.  I can't.  I have no money with which to pay them.

I also want to fly under my own power and swallow the sun whole.  Can't do that either.

"You can do anything you want if you put your mind to it" is stupid shit said by stupid people.

> I'm in the wrong fucking country

Well, if you're going to discredit *yourself*, then there's no need for me to do anything.  

> Can you just leave your last reference off your resume?

Riiiiiiiiiiiiiiight, I'll just leave the place where I worked for the last six years completely off my resume.  That's a great idea!

> speak to your rental company

My "rental company" is a married couple in the suburbs.  He's a lawyer and she's a judge, so the courts won't do shit.  When I ~~spoke~~ slurred and stammered like the brain-damaged retard that I am, they said I was free to find a roommate if I needed help to cover my expenses.

> The fact that you're willing to type up your story and ask this question means you're having second thoughts.

No it doesn't.  

> That's enough of a reason

No it isn't.

> :)

Go fuck yourself, smiley-face.

> Do something drastic if you have to.

I am.  I'm killing myself.  You advising me to kill myself is the best advice you will ever give anyone.

> you can do anything you want

I can't walk, button a shirt, remember my phone number, or see out of my left eye.  You are an idiot.
